title: Yellow Yolk American Eggs Frittata
description: Spicy and silky, this flexitarian-friendly frittata features the nutty flavor of tahini paste and the smoky essence of Binchotan charcoal, perfect for a weekend brunch.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk the eggs and a pinch of salt until well combined.
In a separate bowl, mix the tahini paste and binchotan charcoal powder.
In a mini cocotte, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the red pepper flakes and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Pour the egg mixture into the cocotte and cook until the edges start to set.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese and chopped parsley over the eggs.
Dollop the tahini paste mixture on top of the eggs.
Transfer the cocotte to the preheated oven and bake for 12 minutes, until the eggs are just set and the cheese is melted.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 2 minutes.
Run a spatula around the edges of the cocotte to loosen the frittata.
Slide the frittata onto a plate and serve hot.
